record.question: Preservative commonly used for preserving protozoan trophozoites and cysts in stool samples:
record.explanation: Official final key: A — 10% Formalin. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 6, printed Q94. Source limitation: CDC explicitly says formalin inadequately preserves trophozoite morphology, while stem requires both trophozoites and cysts; no supported complete option. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
